question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the given word.

Immune
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Immune"** means protected or exempt, especially from an obligation or the effects of something; having a high degree of resistance to a disease. (प्रतिरक्षित)

 
 
• **Example:** After receiving the vaccine, she was** immune** to the virus.
 
 
 
• **"Resistant"** refers to the ability to prevent something from having an effect; not affected by something. (प्रतिरोधक)
 
 
• **Example:** Some bacteria are **resistant** to antibiotics.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Immune'** is **'Resistant'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Asleep** (सोया हुआ): In a state of sleep.

 
 
• **Example:** The baby was sound** asleep** in her crib.
 
 
 
• **Variable** (परिवर्तनीय): Not consistent or having a fixed pattern; liable to change.
 
 
• **Example:** The weather in the mountains is highly** variable.**
 
 
 
• **Safe** (सुरक्षित): Protected from or not exposed to danger or risk; not likely to be harmed or lost.
 
 
• **Example:** The children are **safe **at home.
